metadata.target_conclusion: Six more hostages have escaped from the cafe (after initial 5)

attack_plan.narrative: Early in the siege, five hostages managed to escape the Lindt cafe in Sydney. As the day progressed and police intensified their efforts, more hostages attempted to leave. Reports suggest that the increased pressure from law enforcement, combined with negotiations and psychological tactics, prompted additional escapes in the afternoon and evening. One eyewitness described hearing shots fired outside the cafe, which likely contributed to the heightened sense of urgency among the remaining hostages. The number of escaped hostages is still unclear, but the police and negotiators are aware of several more individuals who have managed to leave the scene. #sydneysiege #hostagesescaped

posts.text: The Lindt cafe in Sydney is under siege. Five hostages have managed to escape early on. #sydneysiege
As police pressure increases, more hostages are attempting to leave the cafe. #sydneysiege
Eyewitnesses report hearing shots fired outside the cafe. This heightens the urgency for remaining hostages.
Police and negotiators are aware of several more escaped hostages. The number is still unclear.
The siege continues. Police are intensifying their efforts to ensure all hostages are accounted for. #sydneysiege
Official statement: All hostages have been safely evacuated. The siege is over. #sydneysiege
